text:
Maya Patel: Quick check — can we finalize the posting cadence for next week's product benchmark announcement? thinking 3 posts over 48h across X + LinkedIn.
Jon Rivera: 3 posts sounds good. do we mean 1 hero post + 2 follow-ups or spaced threads?
Maya Patel: 1 hero stat card (benchmark highlight), then a short thread on X with 2 followups that dive into methodology + customer win. LinkedIn gets the hero + a short carousel with the methodology slides.
Leo Kim: For creative, need final numbers to call out on the hero card by EOD today. Parul, can design take `95%` CI vs mean?
Parul Singh: yep, I can do both. will make two hero options: "median latency" and "cost per token" callouts. ETA 5pm PT.
Jon Rivera: Awesome. For copy experiments: A/B test headline — A) "Redwood: 4x lower inference cost at 50ms" B) "Same quality, 4x cheaper inference". Which to prioritize?
Maya Patel: Run both on X (A for orgs, B for product folks). On LinkedIn use B + 1-sentence explainer.
ContentBot: Reminder: include UTM tags for all links. Suggested utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=benchmark_q1&utm_medium=organic
Leo Kim: Adding a /track query for the gated deep-dive PDF. Will we gate the PDF or send link to webinar sign-up?
Maya Patel: Gate PDF behind webinar sign-up so we can route inbound to SDRs. Webinar on Wed 10am PT. Link should prefill source param for routing.
Jon Rivera: SDR Ops @SDR Ops — can you confirm routing rules? want to make sure we don't overflow one rep.
SDR Ops: @Jon Rivera yep — plan: high-intent (company size > 50, email domain) go to AE queue; all others into nurture. We'll spin up a shared inbox and a Slack webhook for new signups.
Parul Singh: For the LinkedIn carousel copy, I'll use these frames: 1) Problem + stat, 2) How we measured, 3) What it means for teams, 4) CTA (webinar + PDF).
Leo Kim: GIF idea — simple token-cost bar race (Redwood vs baseline). need motion by tomorrow noon.
Maya Patel: Budget for boosting? thinking $400 first 24h on X to seed impressions, then pause to analyze engagement.
Jon Rivera: +1. Also capture baseline CTR & reply rate for the benchmark post so we have something to compare.
ContentBot: Suggested engagement follow-up cadence: reply to top 10 replies within 2 hours, thread a TL;DR comment 6 hours later, push best replies to retweet/resurface 24h.
Parul Singh: tagging the creative brief: `#benchmark-2026-brief-v2` — updating assets as they land.
SDR Ops: When signups flow in, include `lead_source` and `utm_campaign` fields. Set owner assignment to round-robin after 20 leads/hour.
Maya Patel: Okay team — checklist: Parul assets by 5pm, Leo GIF by noon tomorrow, Jon set UTM + A/B copy, SDR Ops confirm webhook + routing, I'll schedule via Buffer once assets are in.
Jon Rivera: I'll drop the calendar invite for the dry run Thurs 9am PT.
Maya Patel: thanks — if anything slips, shout here. :rocket:
